documents.name: index

sections.heading: Mission
sections.holds: why the business exists, in one or two sentences a stranger can repeat.

sections.heading: Canvas
sections.holds: the nine blocks of the business model canvas as bullet points, each pointing into the document that holds the detail.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.holds: the business goals for the end of year one, each with its measure. The owner's personal goals live in team.

sections.heading: Documents
sections.holds: the map, one line per document in reading order.

documents.summary: The business on a page. Its title is the business's name with the tagline beneath it, and its summary paragraph is the pitch: who it serves, what it sells and why them, in words that survive being read aloud in a minute.

documents.name: product

sections.heading: Idea
sections.holds: where it came from, why it will work, and the alternatives it was preferred to.

sections.heading: Value proposition
sections.holds: why a customer buys here rather than elsewhere, problem first, then the offer and its benefit.

sections.heading: Products and services
sections.holds: each line, who buys it, the add-on that lifts the sale, and which lines earn most of the income.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.holds: the strategy and its justification, the unit economics of each line; the `price-list` block.

sections.heading: Terms of sale
sections.holds: credit, warranties and refunds.

sections.heading: Place and hours
sections.holds: where the business operates from, when it trades and how it is reached.

sections.heading: Partners and activities
sections.holds: who the business depends on and what it must do week to week.

sections.heading: Resources and suppliers
sections.holds: what it needs to operate, where each comes from and the alternatives weighed, how buying is done, the quotes held, upkeep and usage; the `suppliers` block.

sections.heading: Action plan
sections.holds: the dated, owned steps to launch and through year one; the `action-plan` block.

sections.heading: Travel
sections.holds: business travel, its purpose and cost, or that there is none.

sections.heading: Developments
sections.holds: what happened that the plan did not foresee, and what changed as a result.

documents.summary: What the business sells and how it delivers it.

documents.name: market

sections.heading: Research
sections.holds: what the research drew on, the market's size and direction, the price points customers accept, whether suppliers can be relied on, and the ethical, cultural or environmental considerations that bear on trading.

sections.heading: Customers
sections.holds: the primary customer profiled as a person or an organisation, the need the business meets for them, and the secondary market or the reason there is none.

sections.heading: Discovery
sections.holds: what potential customers were asked, what they said, and what changed because of it.

sections.heading: Competitors
sections.holds: named rivals and substitutes with strengths, weaknesses and the comparison; the `competitors` block.

sections.heading: SWOT
sections.holds: strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, each specific to this business.

sections.heading: Competitive advantage
sections.holds: what the business does that its competitors do not, in the customer's terms.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.holds: the marketing objective and the targets it is measured by.

sections.heading: Channels
sections.holds: the marketing channels and the one that leads, how each is worked, and the sales channels and payment options customers buy through.

sections.heading: Customer journey
sections.holds: how a customer is acquired, kept, grown and asked for referrals, from first hearing of the business onward.

sections.heading: Promotion
sections.holds: the activities, their budget and who runs them; the `activity-calendar` block.

sections.heading: Review
sections.holds: how channels are monitored, how often results are reviewed, what was measured and what was done about it.

documents.summary: Who buys, who else sells, and how customers are found and kept.

sections.heading: Name and tagline
sections.holds: the registered name, the trading name where it differs, the tagline and what it compresses, and the clearance of the name.

sections.heading: Positioning
sections.holds: the one thing the business is for, for whom, against what alternative.

sections.heading: Archetypes
sections.holds: the primary and secondary archetype, and what each licenses and forbids in tone.

sections.heading: Voice
sections.holds: how the business speaks, with examples of on and off.

sections.heading: Identity
sections.holds: logo, colour, type and mascot, each choice traced to the positioning.

sections.heading: Assets
sections.holds: where the brand appears and the rule that keeps it consistent.

documents.name: legal

sections.heading: Structure
sections.holds: the legal structure chosen and what follows from it for banking, liability and tax.

sections.heading: Registrations
sections.holds: ABN, business name, GST position and tax registrations, each with its number and date or the step that obtains it.

sections.heading: Licences and codes
sections.holds: the licences, permits, qualifications, memberships and codes of practice the business trades under, and the rights attached to what it buys and sells.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.holds: each class held or quoted, with insurer, cover, premium and renewal; the `insurance` block.

sections.heading: Work health and safety
sections.holds: the framework that applies and how it is met wherever the business works.

sections.heading: Risk register
sections.holds: the risks, rated and treated, and the procedure that keeps the register alive; the `risk-register` block.

sections.heading: Employing people
sections.holds: the obligations that start with the first wage, or that there are none yet.

sections.heading: Rights and contracts
sections.holds: the contracts the business signs and the matters that need a lawyer.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.holds: what the business will not do or sell, and the standards its content keeps.

sections.heading: Obligations register
sections.holds: every obligation with its authority, due date and owner; the `obligations` block.

sections.heading: Compliance checks
sections.holds: how compliance is checked, how often, and what happens when a check fails.

sections.heading: Records
sections.holds: what is kept, for how long, where, how it is backed up and how it is disposed of.

documents.summary: The law the business trades under and how it keeps to it.

documents.name: finance

sections.heading: Funding
sections.holds: whether finance beyond the owner's means is needed and by what process that was decided, then every source with its amount, cost and the step that obtains it; the `funding` block.

sections.heading: Startup costs
sections.holds: every asset owned and every purchase or lease needed to open, valued, with its supplier, and totalled; the `startup-costs` block.

sections.heading: Costs
sections.holds: the major costs and every expense in the month it falls; the `expenses` block.

sections.heading: Sales projection
sections.holds: two years by month and by line, built from capacity and seasonality, starting when trading starts; the `sales-projection` block.

sections.heading: Owner's finances
sections.holds: the owner's balance sheet and household budget for both years, kept apart from the business, and when any outside income ends; the `personal-budget` block.

sections.heading: Cash flow
sections.holds: the forecast for both years and the working capital that keeps every month at or above zero.

sections.heading: Profit and loss
sections.holds: both years, with net profit set against what the owner needs and against everything taken out below it.

sections.heading: Break even
sections.holds: the sales that cover costs in each year and the margin above them.

sections.heading: Management
sections.holds: the terms the owner works in, how actuals are reviewed against the plan and the plan revised, tax provisioning, working capital, debt collection, reporting and the tools used.

documents.summary: The numbers, and the words around them.

sections.heading: People
sections.holds: who is in the business and what each does; for a sole trader, the owner.

sections.heading: Motivation
sections.holds: why the owner is doing this.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.holds: what the owner expects the business to do for them by the end of year one, with a measure.

sections.heading: Commitment
sections.holds: the hours a week and the resources committed, and that they are enough for the plan.

sections.heading: Strengths
sections.holds: what the owner brings and how each strength is used.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.holds: the personal factors that could stop the owner, and what is done about each.

sections.heading: Advisers
sections.holds: where legal, financial, marketing and compliance advice comes from, what it costs and what it changed.

history.change: first draft. Seven documents, thirteen data blocks, sections fixed from the 126 criteria of the library.
the generic anatomy moved to `../beet_doceval/documents.md`; name clearance added to the brand document's first section.
the data block columns typed, and enforced by `evals/structure.md`.
